$comment: Source of truth for the RSC/CSS-first architecture and component verification. clientDefault: true means the Tier 0 server shell exists but the default entry ships the client island.

0.name: RSC — zero client JavaScript
0.note: State is S1 (native element) or none. Must pass the javaScriptEnabled:false suite completely.

1.name: RSC shell + thin client island
1.note: Native element owns state; JS only syncs ARIA or adds a small behavior (hover intent, auto-dismiss).

2.name: Client component — pre-hydration SSR
2.note: Single client entry. SSR emits native-first markup (Popover API, invoker commands) where possible; keyboard, filtering, and ARIA sync require hydration.

stateSources.S1: Native element state — browser owns it and updates the accessibility tree itself
stateSources.S2: Hidden input + :has() propagation — CSS-readable, ARIA needs a client island

accordion.note: Native details/summary disclosure; name groups single-open items. Built on @gunkin/uiify/elements/details.

alert-modal.note: Native modal alertdialog via show-modal; Cancel/Action are request-close invokers. Baseline Chrome 139 / Firefox 147 / Safari 26.2; below it UIEnhance's invoker fallback runs the command after hydration.

breadcrumb.note: Ellipsis expand/collapse is a native details/summary disclosure, built on @gunkin/uiify/elements/details.

candle-chart.note: Static OHLC geometry is computed during render and expressed as percentage CSS custom properties; the decorative candle glyphs have an accessible table fallback.

line-chart.note: Static line segments are computed during render and expressed as percentage CSS custom properties; the decorative CSS line has an accessible table fallback.

carousel.note: Server shell: native overflow, CSS Scroll Snap, direct fragment links and finite per-slide navigation without JavaScript. Active dots and autoplay require /client; /fade adds CSS transitions. Generated controls remain a separate site experiment.

checkbox.note: Native checkbox + label; default entry ships controlled callbacks with use client.

modal.note: True modal via show-modal/request-close; the browser owns inertness, Escape and focus return. Controlled/initially open state lives in @gunkin/uiify/components/modal/client. Trigger/Close built on @gunkin/uiify/elements/dialog.

drawer.note: DrawerPanel native shell + compound Drawer.* client API; snap-point drag on client entry.

popup.note: Native parts anchor to their invoker (implicit anchor) and carry no aria-expanded; Chromium exposes expanded through the accessibility tree, other engines are unmeasured. The legacy Popup.Root compound keeps UIEnhance for its DOM attribute. Trigger/Content/Close built on @gunkin/uiify/elements/popover.

radio-group.note: Data-driven native radio group; browser owns selection. Built on @gunkin/uiify/elements/choice (Phase 7 T6).

rating.note: Native radio group; hover preview and persisted selection are pure CSS (:checked/:hover sibling rules), no JS. Controlled value/onValueChange lives in the separate rating/client entry. Built on @gunkin/uiify/elements/choice (Phase 7 T6).

select.note: Native text-only select; appearance:base-select is a Chrome+Safari cosmetic enhancement and Firefox keeps the OS picker.

table.note: Sorting is out of scope — DOM mutation cannot be CSS.

textarea.note: field-sizing:content replaces the auto-grow JS. Baseline since Firefox 152.

toggle.note: Native checkbox + label toggle; browser owns pressed state.

tooltip.clientDoes: hover/focus intent delay — interestfor + popover=hint are Chrome/Firefox only, no Safari

toast.clientDoes: auto-dismiss timer, live-region announcement — CSS has no timers for logic

stepper.note: Data-driven native radio flow; validation gating is out of scope. Built on @gunkin/uiify/elements/choice (Phase 7 T6).

header.clientDoes: composite — audit against the sub-parts it composes

tabs.note: Data-driven native radio switcher; CSS-only panels. Built on @gunkin/uiify/elements/choice (Phase 7 T6).

dropdown-menu.clientDoes: roving focus, typeahead, checkbox/radio state, submenu keyboard behavior

combobox.ariaGap: filtering is impossible in CSS — pre-hydration shows the unfiltered list

context-menu.clientDoes: contextmenu event — no CSS hook exists at all

color-picker.clientDoes: synchronizes the displayed CSS value and preview with the native color input; the browser owns the OS picker UI.

virtual-scroll.clientDoes: windowed rendering for long fixed-height lists
